cuerpos.titulo: Binance Will Support the Fetch.ai (FET) and Terra Classic (LUNC) Network Upgrades
cuerpos.cuerpo: Fellow Binancians, Binance will support the Fetch.ai (FET) and Terra Classic (LUNC) network upgrades. The Fetch.ai (FET) network upgrade will take place at the Fetch.ai block height of 11,235,813 , or approximately at 2023-05-23 13:00 (UTC). Deposits and withdrawals of FET will be suspended approximately starting from 2023-05-23 12:00 (UTC). The Terra Classic (LUNC) network upgrade will take place at the Terra Classic block height of 12,902,400 , or approximately at 2023-05-23 22:00 (UTC). Deposits and withdrawals for LUNC and USTC via the Terra Classic (LUNC) network will be suspended approximately starting from 2023-05-23 21:30 (UTC). Please note: The trading of FET, LUNC and USTC will not be affected during the network upgrades. While the Fetch.ai (FET) network upgrade will take place at the Fetch.ai block height of 11,235,813 , the Terra Classic (LUNC) network upgrade will take place at the Terra Classic block height of 12,902,400 . The estimated timings are for users’ reference only. Binance will handle all technical requirements involved for all users holding FET, LUNC and USTC in their Binance accounts. We will reopen deposits and withdrawals for FET, LUNC and USTC once we deem the upgraded networks to be stable, and we will not notify users in a further announcement. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. For more information on the network upgrades, please refer to the following: Fetch.ai Release V0.10.7 Fetch.ai Proposal 19 Terra Classic Community's Latest Burn Tax Proposal
